messages:
sam.k: kicking off a co-marketing play with KiteCloud — goal: marketplace listing + joint webinar in 3 weeks. need owners for landing, routing, rehearsal, and post-webinar content.
ivy.pmm: i'll draft hero copy (tech + exec variants) and the blog outline. want one benchmark-led headline and one outcomes-led headline.
ben.gtm: i'll build the landing + registration flow. propose Tue/Thu mornings PT. landing will AB test CTAs: 'Start trial' vs 'Request private demo' split by cookie.
rachel.prod: i'll own the demo and the bench narrative. pinged eng for conservative latency + cost deltas; must get numbers by Wed AM or we use percent deltas only.
ops.bot: created Marketo list MKTO_Kite_Apr2026 and SFDC routing queue KitePartner_Webinar_Apr. Job 9120 scheduled.
ben.gtm: routing rules: source=="kite_market" OR utm_campaign=="kite_partner_apr" => add to MKTO_Kite_Apr2026; tag role=eng|platform => technical_lead. map high-intent to SDR pool B.
sam.k: partner assets needed: co-branded hero PNG, 1-sentence quote, and a 30s clip. partner deadline: 2026-04-14 5pm PT. legal already signed.
ivy.pmm: landing copy drafts posted: link in drive. two hero variants: "Predictable inference, same API across hosted/dedicated/private" (tech) and "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" (exec). feedback welcome.
rachel.prod: rehearsal scheduled Mon 10am PT. demo plan: 8m product walkthrough, 10m customer panel, 15m Q&A. show infra switch in <90s.
ben.gtm: follow-up plan: 24h recording + CTA email, 7-day nurture with SDR one-pager + benchmark PDF. Sam will own nurture flow.
ops.bot: reminder: legal allowed assets: logo (PNG/SVG), one quote <=50 words, 30-60s video.
sam.k: next steps: Ivy finalize copy EOD, Ben lander live by Thu, Rachel final demo + eng numbers by Wed AM, partner assets by Thu 5pm. readiness check Fri.
ivy.pmm: will post updates here. excited to get this out. :rocket:
